title: The Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009
full_text: The Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200927 Act Number: 27 Enactment Date: 2009-03-20 Act Year: 2009 Short Title: The Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009 Long Title: An Act to provide for the prevention, control and eradication of infectious and contagious diseases affecting animals, for prevention of outbreak or spreading of such diseases from one State to another, and to meet the international obligations of India for facilitating import and export of animals and animal products and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of LIVESTOCK DEVELOPMENT Enforcement Date: 25-08-2009 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 25th August, 2009, vide notification No S.O. 2158(E), dated 24th August, 2009, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
